# A rabbit popping out of a hole (spare it!): a pale round body, a head with two tall ears, dark eyes,
# a khaki nose. Cut at the ground like the mole. Up Z, facing -Y, origin on the ground.
new
add mesh uv-sphere --name Body --segments 8 --rings 6 --radius 1 --location 0 0 0.1
scale 0.22 0.2 0.32
apply --scale
apply --location
mode edit
select all
bisect --plane-co 0 0 0 --plane-no 0 0 1 --clear-inner
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Head --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.17 --location 0 -0.04 0.46
add mesh cube --name EarL --size 1 --location -0.08 0 0.74
scale 0.09 0.05 0.36
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -10 0
add mesh cube --name EarR --size 1 --location 0.08 0 0.74
scale 0.09 0.05 0.36
apply --scale
set rotation 0 10 0
material new Fur --base-color 0.627 0.725 0.729
select Body Head EarL EarR
material assign Fur
add mesh cube --name InL --size 1 --location -0.085 -0.03 0.74
scale 0.05 0.03 0.26
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -10 0
add mesh cube --name InR --size 1 --location 0.085 -0.03 0.74
scale 0.05 0.03 0.26
apply --scale
set rotation 0 10 0
material new Inner --base-color 0.467 0.361 0.310
select InL InR
material assign Inner
add mesh ico-sphere --name Nose --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.035 --location 0 -0.2 0.44
material new Nose --base-color 0.631 0.624 0.486
material assign Nose
add mesh ico-sphere --name EyeL --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.028 --location -0.075 -0.14 0.51
add mesh ico-sphere --name EyeR --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.028 --location 0.075 -0.14 0.51
material new Eye --base-color 0.090 0.055 0.098
select EyeL EyeR
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export rabbit.glb
